CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Medical Center

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Specimen: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Down syndrome investigation

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis (Karyotype)

PRIOR TESTING
Rapid aneuploidy PCR screening previously performed

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. A minimum of 20 cells were analyzed at the 450-550 band level resolution.

RESULTS
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype

No evidence of trisomy 21 detected
No other numerical or structural chromosomal abnormalities identified

INTERPRETATION
G-banded chromosome analysis reveals a normal female karyotype with no evidence of trisomy 21 (Down syndrome) or other chromosomal abnormalities. This result is concordant with the prior rapid PCR screening.

CLINICAL IMPLICATIONS
Down syndrome and other major chromosomal disorders are excluded by this analysis.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
